# Documentation Standards & Maintenance

This directory contains documentation governance files for the x402 facilitator project.

## Files

- **[DOCUMENTATION.md](DOCUMENTATION.md)** - Complete documentation standards, hierarchy, and maintenance rules

## Purpose

Maintains consistent, well-organized documentation across:
- 7 main documentation files (START_HERE → ARCHITECTURE → guides)
- Clear audience targeting (users vs developers vs operators)
- Proper cross-referencing and navigation
- Regular update schedules

## For Contributors

Before creating or updating documentation:

1. Read [DOCUMENTATION.md](DOCUMENTATION.md) for standards
2. Identify the appropriate document for your changes
3. Follow formatting guidelines
4. Update cross-references if needed
5. Run the documentation checklist

## Quick Reference

| If you want to... | Edit this file |
|-------------------|---------------|
| Add a new feature | README.md + relevant guide |
| Document deployment | DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md |
| Add admin procedure | SETTLEMENT_GUIDE.md |
| Coordinate with agents | AGENT_COORDINATION.md |
| Explain architecture | ARCHITECTURE.md |
| Update navigation | PROJECT_INDEX.md |
| Add quick link | START_HERE.md |
